description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Wormfang Drake.
Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
uses.cardState: as a copy of Wormfang Drake

uses.name: Wormfang Drake
uses.cardState: exiled by Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
